title: Anth.us onto the standard front end (production, gated phases)

comments.author: home
comments.text: Closed with phases a, b, d, e live and verified; c and f not reached, filed under PPY-e8db7c. Anth.us-web PRs 96 (a: SEO, sitemap, robots, guard to core, Papyrus 5.4.0), 97 (b: rendition catalog replaces site-state.json), 98 (d: render state object, items rendered in process), 99 (e: pattern redirects as data, edge function compiled by core; stack papyrus-edge-anth-us change set phase-e-core-edge-function). Papyrus PRs 433 (PageHead.headline), 436 (directory canonical URLs, /404, papyrus-infra compile-edge-function), 438 (RenditionCatalog.all_records), 439 (deployed edge template); releases 5.4.0 and 5.5.0. Each phase: parity on every URL (1,107 live, 908 local) with 0 blocking differences, 10 screenshots (home, article, listing, about, engage at 1440 and 390) pixel-identical or within 0.02/255, a 3 s poll through the change with no non-200 HTTP response, live crawl equal to the local projection. Evidence: STATE.md and rep-*.json under .baselines/std-anthus in the Projects directory.
